name: Camera-Calibrated Differentiable Holographic Model
definition: A differentiable computational model that simulates the physical propagation of light from an SLM to a camera sensor, including learnable parameters to account for system-specific imperfections (polarization, curvature, beam profiles, higher orders, crosstalk, LUT non-linearity).
summary: A differentiable model simulating light propagation from an SLM to a camera, distinguished by using a neural network to calibrate system imperfections like crosstalk and non-linearity against experimental data.
